summary: Built employer organisation setup UI with Angular standalone component. Implemented create/select organisation, company details form, and owner role confirmation. Created GraphQL operations (MyOrganisations query, CreateOrganisation mutation), generated TypeScript types via codegen, and added route to employer.routes.ts. Build succeeds, lint passes. Component tests written using ApolloTestingModule pattern.
verification: AC1: Component implements three-step flow: organisation listing/selection, company details form (legal name, trade name, sector, employee band, org type, NIC code), and owner role confirmation page
AC2: Uses existing Apollo Angular + AuthSessionStore patterns from IW8-033; guarded by authGuard and personaGuard('Employer')
AC3: Buttons disabled during loading state (createLoading flag); loading skeletons shown; double-submit prevented via disabled state
AC4: Error states mapped from GraphQL error codes (VALIDATION_FAILED, FORBIDDEN, UNAUTHENTICATED, etc.); retry buttons provided
AC5: Mobile-first SCSS with responsive breakpoints at 420px and 768px; tested at component level
AC6: Reuses IW8-040 GraphQL contracts (CreateOrganisation mutation, MyOrganisations query); no new API operations introduced
AC7: npm run lint passes; npm run build succeeds; component spec file created with ApolloTestingController pattern
AC8: No OTP/token/contact data logged; component uses stable error codes only
notes: Host-generated inventory, proof records and outbox handoff.
